# ship-view_errors

Your interface to the `view_errors` ops. Invoke each over ConnectRPC:

```
ship ops call <name> --json '<args-json>'
```

Reads are safe (C0). Commands carry a blast-radius class. Open an op's reference
page for full args, return shape, capability, and an example.

## Reads

- [`view_errors.clear`](references/docs/view_errors.clear.mdoc) — Clear recorded view runtime errors.
- [`view_errors.list`](references/docs/view_errors.list.mdoc) — List recorded view runtime errors.
- [`view_errors.post`](references/docs/view_errors.post.mdoc) — Record a view runtime error reported by the browser.
